relics.name: Overflow
relics.desc: Overkill damage chains to the nearest enemy. Chain kills chain again.

relics.name: Frostbite
relics.desc: Slowed enemies take +50% damage from everything. Stacks.

relics.name: Loadbearing
relics.desc: Towers touching the Core block get triple range.

relics.name: Second Wind
relics.desc: The Core mends 2 health every time a wave launches.

relics.name: Quarry
relics.desc: Rock breaks three times faster - every prospect job, everywhere.

relics.name: Toll
relics.desc: Every enemy pays 1 Scrap for each cell it walks beside a tower. Stacks.

relics.name: Bounty Board
relics.desc: Bosses pay half again as much Scrap.

relics.name: Orbital Lance
relics.desc: Strike anywhere: 400 damage in a 3-cell blast. Recharges slowly. A second copy is a second charge.

relics.name: Stasis Field
relics.desc: Freeze every enemy for 4 seconds. Towers keep firing. A second copy is a second charge.

relics.name: Deep Vein
relics.desc: Refineries produce five-fold for 20 seconds. A second copy is a second charge.

relics.name: Sandbags
relics.desc: Use: the Core gains 15 health, and 15 to its maximum. One use.

relics.name: Flashbang
relics.desc: Use: every enemy freezes for 2 seconds. One use.

relics.name: Ore Pocket
relics.desc: Use: 20 Ore, right now. One use.
